## Comm bridge test

This page tests that the Python-to-JavaScript comm bridge works by
creating a comm, opening it, and sending a message using the raw
`comm` module (no ipywidgets dependency).

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
import comm

# Pass data to constructor (matches ipywidgets pattern)
# BaseComm constructor auto-opens, so no explicit open() needed
c = comm.create_comm(target_name="test_target", data={"msg": "hello from python"})
c.send(data={"count": 42})
print("comm messages sent")
```
